title: NCPatcher file manifest
description: The ROM's NitroFS table after a build, with per-entry provenance. Written by files-dump, by `ncpatcher rom files --json`, or by `ncpatcher files plan --json` for a build that has not happened yet. Consumers turn file ids into constants, or show what a project changes about a ROM.

variant.description: The variant this build produced. Absent when the run had no variant, which includes `rom files --json` reading a ROM off disk.

planned.description: Present and true only in a document written by `ncpatcher files plan`, which reports what a build would place without building. Every id under z_new/ in one is a prediction that a build confirms; everything else is read from the ROM as it stands. Absent means a build wrote this.

files.description: Every file in the table, not only the ones this run wrote: a generator naming files by id needs the whole table, and most of it is whatever the ROM already had. Sorted by id.

id.description: The FAT index, exactly as the ROM stores it. A game that offsets file ids at run time (NSMB subtracts its overlay count) applies that itself; it is a property of that game, not of the ROM. Existing ids are never renumbered by a build.

path.description: Slash-separated path inside NitroFS, with no leading slash. This is the name the file has now: an entry that claimed an id was renamed on the way in.

action.description: What this run did to the file, relative to the ROM that came in. `created` means the build appended it, which only happens under z_new/.

source.description: Where the bytes came from, relative to the project directory when the file is inside it. Present only when this run wrote the file, and absent for z_new/reserved, which NCPatcher creates out of nothing.

module.description: The module whose tree supplied the file. Absent for a project-level files: entry.

component.description: The component that names this destination in its files: patterns. Ownership only: a disabled component's files are subtracted before insertion, so nothing here is ever attributed to one.

from-variant.description: Which layer of a layered tree supplied the file: the built variant, or the base variant underneath it. Grouping by path across manifests answers which variants translate a file.

source-missing.description: Planning only, and present only when true: the source named above was not on disk to be measured, because a hook generates it. The destination, the id and the provenance still hold; the size does not. A build never reports this, because it refuses to start without the file.

members.description: Present only for a Nitro archive this run edited, and then only for the members it edited. A container's own entry can carry no more provenance than its members agree on, which for five members from three modules is none, so the per-member truth would otherwise be lost. Members the run did not touch are deliberately absent: enumerating every member of every archive would dwarf the rest of the document, and a consumer holding the ROM can list them itself. Sorted by index.

index.description: The member's position in its container, which is how the game addresses it. Never an `id`: a member index is not a NitroFS file id, the ROM's table does not name members at all, and treating the two alike would replace the wrong file.

path.description: Slash-separated path inside the archive, as the container's own name table spells it. The address a `files:` entry writes for it is `<container path>!<this>`.

size.description: Size in bytes of the member after this run.

action.description: Always `modified` in practice, since only edited members are listed. Never `created`: the archive codec is replace-only, because a game reads a member by index and inserting one renumbers every member after it.

source.description: Where the member's bytes came from, relative to the project directory when it is inside it.

module.description: The module whose tree supplied the member.

component.description: The component that names this member in its files: patterns.

from-variant.description: Which layer of a layered tree supplied the member.

source-missing.description: As on a file entry: planning only, and only when true.
